summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** # **Petition No. 122/MP/2019** **Coram:** **Shri I. S. Jha, Member Shri Arun Goyal, Member Shri P.K.Singh, Member** # **Date of Order: 20** **th** **June, 2022** # **In the matter of** Petition under Section 79(1)(f) of the Electricity Act, 2003 for adjudication of dispute arising out of the action of Power Grid Corporation of India in raising Bill-3 in contravention of Regulation 11 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Sharing of Inter State Transmission Charges and Losses) Regulations, 2010. # **And In the matter of** **Essar Power (MP) Limited,** Essar House, 11 K.K. Marg, Mahalaxmi, Mumbai – 400034 .. **Petitioner** **Vs.** # **Power Grid Corporation of India Limited,** Saudamini, Plot No. – 2, Sector – 29 Near IFFCO Chowk Metro Station Gurgaon – 122 001, Haryana .. **Respondent** # ** ORDER ** The Petitioner, Essar Power (MP) Limited, has filed the present Petition along with the following prayers: _“(a) Declare that in terms of Regulation 11 of the Sharing Regulations 2010, the Petitioner is entitled to the offset of charges for STOA against the charges for LTA in both Bill-1 and Bill-3 raised during the LTA Period i.e. 01.10.2017 to 03.05.2018;_ _(b) Direct PGCIL to revise all Bill-3 issued thus far for EPMPL for the LTA Period and to factor in the STOA offset in the same manner as it has been provided in Bill-1;_ Order in 122/MP/2019 Page 1 _(c) Grant such order, further relief(s) in the facts and circumstances of the case as this Ld. Commission may deem just and equitable in favour of the Petitioner.”_ 2. Learned counsel for the Petitioner vide its letter dated 14.6.2022 has submitted that the Petitioner does not wish to pursue the present Petition. Accordingly, learned counsel for the Petitioner has sought permission to withdraw the present Petition. 3. The Petition is being decided by circulation. In view of the submission of the learned counsel for the Petitioner vide its letter dated 14.6.2022, the Petitioner is permitted to withdraw the present Petition. 4. Accordingly, the Petition No. 122/MP/2019 is disposed of as withdrawn. # **Sd/-** **Sd/sd/sd/(P.K.Singh) (Arun Goyal) Member Member** Order in 122/MP/2019 Page 2 CERC Website S. No. 340/2022
